algorithm_scope: Nonlinear least-squares solver, not evidence of Xbox hinge construction
derivation: Sphere: squared distance to center equals radius squared. Algebraic linear least squares initializes center/radius; geometric residual is norm(point-center)-radius. Center and scale data before solving.
selection: Whole LeftThumb/RightThumb and Joystick-Left/Right-Ring objects; additionally every exact-weld connected component when split. No hand-picked residual threshold or inlier rejection.
validation: Evaluate vertex radial residuals plus triangle-centroid radial residuals. Centroids are a geometric discretization check, not independent measured validation data.
numerical_controls: Normalized solver ftol/xtol/gtol 1e-12; numerical convergence only, not a physical acceptance tolerance
decision: Do not choose the best-looking center: components produce very different centers and small residual alone does not identify a hinge. Retain target pivot null.
next_evidence: 1708 mechanical drawing or calibrated multi-pose geometry/photographs from the same stick; force measurements alone do not locate its pivot.
